notes:
CasaNova: a new app for choosing rooms, seeing what is playing and browsing music, at /CasaNova/ on your server. It can be added to the home screen like Fenix and MusicPort, adapts to phones and tablets, and is available in English, French, Swedish, Spanish, German, Italian, Chinese and Japanese.
Config: the Server Settings page now shows its help text correctly instead of garbled characters.
